create_extractor_for_visualizer: create an extractor for a DensePose visualizer using create_extractor to auto-select the right extractor type
extract_scores_from_instances: extract prediction scores from detectron2 Instances objects with optional index selection filtering
extract_boxes_xywh_from_instances: extract bounding boxes in XYWH format from detectron2 Instances with optional selection
use_densepose_result_extractor: use DensePoseResultExtractor to extract chart results with confidences and bounding boxes from instances
use_nms_filtered_extractor: use NmsFilteredExtractor to apply non-maximum suppression filtering with an IoU threshold before extraction
